story: When I first started learning Vietnamese, I found it increasingly difficult to learn all the vocabulary needed while retaining all of my Japanese and German knowledge. I had tried spaced repetition on flashcards before, and as great as they were for Biology classes, they didn't feel interactive enough for hands-on language learning. That's when I was inspired to build kotobạn.
The name mashes up 言葉 (kotoba, Japanese for “word”) and bạn (Vietnamese for “friend”). Word friend!

kotobạn is a multi-user progressive web app, currently in invite-only closed beta. Under the hood it's FastAPI and SQLite, hosted on US-based Oracle servers with magic-link sign-in, invite requests, and an admin portal.

The content pipeline is the part I'm proudest of: vocabulary and reading material across twelve languages, curated in batches with narration by ElevenLabs. It's the study tool I wished existed, and now it's the one I actually use.
tagline: Learn vocabulary in 12 languages with the power of spaced repetition.
